rationale: The Court is likely to reverse narrowly on AEDPA grounds, holding that Hall/Atkins do not clearly establish (for § 2254(d)(1) purposes) a rule requiring a full adaptive-functioning inquiry whenever valid IQ scores fall in the 70–75 range or SEM overlaps 70, so fairminded jurists could agree with the state court’s disposition. The dissent will argue the state court effectively imposed the IQ-70 gate Hall forbids and that insulating that threshold screen is an unreasonable application of clearly established Eighth Amendment law even on habeas.
